user.title: Connect Paranoid
user.description: Paranoid must already be running in Docker. Enter the API and web interface addresses reachable from Home Assistant and your browser.

data_description.url: Base address of the API, without /health.
data_description.web_url: Address opened by the Visit link on the Paranoid device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Paranoid
reconfigure.description: Change the addresses of the Paranoid API and web interface.

error.invalid_url: Enter valid HTTP(S) URLs without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the API. Check that Paranoid is running and Home Assistant can reach its address.
error.invalid_response: This address did not return Paranoid's health response. Check the API address and port (normally 8000).

abort.already_configured: This Paranoid server is already configured.
